We are kicking off procurement for the pilot environment and need the completed SIG (v2) and supporting evidence. Our procurement team prefers a single, validated package that can be ingested into our vendor portals (Whistic preferred; OneTrust acceptable).

Requirements:

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Consolidated SIG package + portal upload preference

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. We can meet the 2/15 target. Proposed delivery approach:

1) Whistic-ready bundle (preferred for speed): individual evidence PDFs + a signed manifest (export-log.txt) + evidence-index.xlsx mapping question IDs to files. We’ll upload the bundle to Whistic and share the portal link.
2) OneTrust variant: single flattened PDF (SIG-responses-v2.pdf) with embedded bookmarks and a separate checksums file if needed.

We will produce both variants to keep you flexible. Implementation notes: flatten/flatten+stamp for every evidence PDF, preserve original file names, and run a SHA256 checksum on each file. Max file size considerations: Whistic accepts multi-file zips but recommends <25MB chunks for upload stability. OneTrust often wants a single PDF <100MB.

I’ve attached the evidence-index template (evidence-index.xlsx) and will coordinate the upload window. Monica and Karthik — can you confirm we can generate both variants and the expected ETA?

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 15:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: packaging details and tooling notes

Monica / Karthik — quick tech notes for the SIG bundle build (so we have a repeatable runbook):

- Source outputs: SIG-responses-v2.pdf (filled form), plus source evidence PDFs from research, infra, security.
- PDF prep: run pdftk + ghostscript flattening, then apply a small footer stamp: "Redwood Inference — Confidential — Uploaded to Acme Whistic 2027-02-12". Keep a non-flattened backup for archive.
- Naming: "ACMEQ_{questionID}_{short-desc}.pdf" to keep mapping obvious.
- Manifest: CSV with columns (filename, question_id, SHA256, created_by, doc_type). Then export-log.txt is the zipped archive name + timestamp + checksums.
- Chunking: produce both a Zip of per-evidence PDFs (zip parts ~20MB) AND a concatenated PDF for OneTrust (optimize images, linearize for web).
- Portal quirks: Whistic keeps metadata but prefers separate evidence files; OneTrust ingestion often fails if bookmarks are missing — include bookmarks pulled from the SIG response headings.

Can you validate the flatten + stamping step locally and share ETA? I’ll prepare the upload instructions and required access for Acme.

—Jonas

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

ETA: final bundle ready for upload by EOD 2027-02-12.

Monica
